# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

SurfaceScope is a technical project for authorized security work. We want participation to
be professional, respectful and safe, regardless of experience level, background or
identity.

## Expected behavior

- Be direct about technical problems without attacking people.
- Assume good faith and ask for evidence when a claim is unclear.
- Respect authorization boundaries and never encourage scanning systems without consent.
- Do not publish credentials, personal data or third-party scan results.
- Give actionable review feedback and accept correction gracefully.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, discriminatory language or personal attacks.
- Encouraging unauthorized access, destructive testing or data exfiltration.
- Publishing another person's private information, credentials or client data.
- Deliberately submitting malware, hidden payloads or unreviewed binaries.
- Repeated disruption of issues, pull requests or security discussions.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers through the contact
channel on the repository profile. Do not include sensitive third-party data in a public
issue. Maintainers will review reports, limit access where necessary and document actions
only to the extent needed to protect affected people.

## Scope

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews and other
project spaces.
